intro: Part 2: a concession. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

frases.estudio: Selvom rapporten er kort, indeholder den mange detaljer.

frases.estudio: På trods af forsinkelsen nåede holdet frem.
frases.alumno: Despite the delay, the group arrived.

texto: «Fordi» introduces a cause with a clause; «derfor» presents a consequence and, when it opens a main clause, triggers inversion. «Selvom» presents a difficulty that does not invalidate the main idea.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
